en.episode_title: Dino and the Broken Rainbow Bridge
en.description:
Bunny needs help across a broken rainbow bridge! Join Dino and Bunny as they discover circles, triangles and squares, and work towards restoring the bridge. A gentle adventure about shapes, friendship and helping one another.

English audio with English on-screen subtitles.

Produced for Family Learning Hub.
Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@familylearninghub-flh
Explore more: https://familylearninghub.com

#DinoAdventures #FamilyLearningHub #LearningShapes
en.playlist_description: Dino Adventures in English, with English dialogue and on-screen subtitles. Little adventures about friendship, kindness and helping one another. Episodes are arranged in story order.

ms.episode_title: Dino dan Jambatan Pelangi yang Rosak
ms.description:
Bunny memerlukan bantuan di seberang jambatan pelangi yang rosak! Ikuti Dino dan Bunny mencari bulatan, segi tiga dan segi empat sama untuk membaiki jambatan. Sebuah pengembaraan tentang bentuk, persahabatan dan sikap saling membantu.

Audio Bahasa Melayu Malaysia dengan sari kata Bahasa Melayu pada skrin.

Diterbitkan untuk Family Learning Hub.
Saluran: https://www.youtube.com/@familylearninghub-flh
Ketahui lebih lanjut: https://familylearninghub.com
